identitySignals: Name matches registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit 'Chapter 510 Ink' in Oakland, CA, EIN 47-2793034 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), matching the agenda text 'Chapter 510 Ink, Oakland, CA'
Organization's own website shows the same EIN 47-2793034 and an Oakland address
Website describes a youth writing and publishing center and mentions a Westlake Writers' Room at Westlake Middle School, matching the OUSD Westlake Middle School agreement
Website mentions teaching artists in classrooms across Oakland Unified School District schools, matching OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' contracts
research.notes: Legal name per IRS/ProPublica is 'Chapter 510 Ink'; the website brands it 'Chapter 510'. WebSearch budget was exhausted, so no CA Secretary of State or SAM.gov lookup was done.

profile.summary: Chapter 510 is an Oakland nonprofit youth writing, bookmaking and publishing center. It describes itself as a safe space for Black, brown and queer youth to find joy and power in writing. It has published youth-written books and runs writing programs, including in Oakland public schools.

review.notes: ProPublica lists Chapter 510 Ink as a 501(c)(3) in Oakland with EIN 47-2793034, matching the EIN on the organization's own site and contact page; the site documents the Westlake Writers' Room and OUSD school programs, matching the agreements. The summary, phone, email and address are all shown on the cited pages.
